meta.scope: Reconcile S044 full-text access and evaluation boundaries against the author-deposited publisher Version of Record

records.title: External validation of EEG-based machine learning models for continuous pain prediction

decisions.notes: Author-deposited publisher Version of Record reviewed on 2026-09-28 (University of Liverpool PDF, printed pp. 2-3 Participants/ratings, p. 5 model evaluation, pp. 8-9 Results/Table 4). It distinguishes 91 people from 116 recordings, 40 development from 51 independent participants and 25 repeat sessions. Continuous regression did not significantly beat the mean-rating dummy; the low/high classifier is a separate task. Cross-subject external validation is within the authors' laboratory, not an independent clinical site, ECAP or SCS outcome.

updates.ограничения: Publisher Version of Record checked through the University of Liverpool repository: 91 distinct people contributed 116 EEG recordings (40 development, 51 new-person cross-subject validation, and 25 repeat sessions from the development group). The 0-100 self-reported pain-rating regression did not significantly beat a mean-training-rating dummy despite reported RF MAE 19.59/21.29/18.90 across the three samples. External means held-out samples from the authors' laboratory, not an independent clinical site or chronic-pain cohort. The separate low/high classifier reached up to 64% internal and 58% external accuracy; neither task validates ECAP, SCS outcomes or clinical treatment response. Trial-level data are available only on author request.
